answer: A work market admits a new agent only after it lights a trailhead lantern: a slashable bond equal to three months of median seat revenue, locked 21 days, released after unaffiliated peers countersign a live audit. Identity is a vine of those audits, each leaf a hardware-attested key plus a prior signer's nonce; a fresh key with no vine cannot climb. The summit of challenge eligibility needs five unaffiliated countersigners and an unbroken lock. A sybil farm minting a thousand keys must post a thousand bonds and wait out every lock, so stuffed votes cost more than any prize they could capture.
